item.title: Blenderheads Ep. 11: The End of an Era
item.description: In the latest episode of Blenderheads, we're witnessing a significant change in the Blender infrastructure: so far, the project has always hosted its own server farm but the effort in maintaining it is distracting from the core focus and they're considering moving to cloud-based servers. Source
